# Feasibility fixtures

Synthetic content only. [Rich text baseline](linkedin-rich-text.html) is a static test input, not application code. Open locally and copy the rendered article body (not source markup). Expected inventory: two headings (H2/H3), paragraphs with Unicode and a line break, bold/italic/inline code, one link to example.com, ordered list with two entries, unordered list with nested entry, quote, divider, two-column table with two data rows, preformatted code block. Record actual paste and reopen behavior; do not publish.
